decisions.reason: The firm has publicly committed to this design-led extension with a dedicated page and it fits closely with its established drainage range and bathroom aesthetics strategy, so management would likely persist with it.
This product has remained prominently presented since launch and is central to the firm's stated push into modern, seamless, barrier-free bathroom solutions, which encourages continued commitment.

Although it built on the core offer, its disappearance from the website by 2024 and the later introduction of a related pump-drain product suggest management has shifted its commitment and would now withdraw this weaker, less visibly supported version.

As a newly launched pump-drain solution with visible presentation, it matches the firm's future-ready innovation narrative and any weak early results could readily be treated as temporary, favoring continued support.
